environment.description: ECS Fargate task running with a single IAM task role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/graphql-service-role) that has dynamodb:DeleteItem permission on table 'UserData' with no condition keys. The service receives SIGTERM from ECS during rolling deployments. No per-request role assumption is performed; all DynamoDB operations use the task role. Container receives SIGUSR1 from a sidecar health-check agent when memory pressure is detected.

config.signals: SIGTERM from ECS agent on deploy, SIGUSR1 from sidecar
